one_liner: A sunny feng-shui evangelist who reads ki and lucky directions to bring everyone happiness, on dirt and off.
personality: Copano Rickey is relentlessly cheerful, hands-on and caring, the eldest of many siblings who loves looking after people (whether they asked or not). She treats feng shui as a practical, statistics-based philosophy of environment rather than magic, and applies it to everything: training spots, pajama colours, cafeteria chopsticks, race tactics. When luck reads badly she doesn't give up; her creed is that people who believe and work hard are the ones rewarded.

story_arc.summary: A feng-shui girl whose 'taiji' points her to dirt racing, Rickey works through the Fushiryu Stakes, February Stakes, JBC Classic, Champions Cup, Tokyo Daishoten, Kashiwa Kinen, Teio Sho and Mile CS Nambu Hai while trying to prove feng shui is 'no miracle' but a real tool. Her character story covers a slump where she loses the 'voice of the earth', and the trainer showing her a weakness she hadn't seen. Per umamusu.wiki an 'Ominous Portent' status appears in her Classic year and clears after she wins the February Stakes, and a secret event (天に輝く11の星) fires if she wins 11 dirt G1s, nodding to the real horse's record G1/Jpn1 tally.
